children: Sweden software provider's Q3 net sales rose 10% yr/yr, with 3% organic growth
Q3 EBITA and net profit both rose sharply from a year earlier
Company signed largest software contract to date and acquired AI-enabled SpaceIntel platform
Company did not provide specific financial guidance for upcoming quarters or full year in its press release
Company expects renewals of three-year agreements in 2027 to support organic growth
ORGANIC GROWTH - Co said organic growth contributed to earnings improvement
ACQUISITIONS - Co said acquisitions supported earnings improvement
ENHANCED EFFICIENCY - Co said improved efficiency helped drive earnings improvement
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 5 "strong buy" or "buy", no "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the it services & consulting peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Addnode Group AB (publ) is SEK70.00, about 23.7% above its October 22 closing price of SEK56.60
The stock recently traded at 19 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 12 three months ago
